product_claim: Per-exit post-sale review queue across sealed Lifecycle books + FTSE control — analysis opinion + learning points on charts; Accept/Comment/Duplicate clear the active (uncommented) queue; factory reply stays in durable history; Duplicate clears same-pattern cross-book noise; never fills or knobs
learning_question: Are relevant charts reviewed with the same big-picture issues the owner sees, and are missed patterns captured into a development loop that responds?
attention_note: Active queue = uncommented exits only (just_sold + post_sale within 21d or return ≤ -5.0%). Accept/Comment/Duplicate clear the card; factory replies stay in durable history (not re-queued). Candidates within 84d still counted for coverage.

duplicate_policy.episode_key: book_id|TICKER|entry_YYYY-MM-DD|exit_YYYY-MM-DD — collapses same-day entry timestamp jitter; keeps worse return_pct
duplicate_policy.cross_book: intentional — same ticker may appear once per sealed book (and FTSE control); book_tag distinguishes them
duplicate_policy.reply_plus_original: Comment clears the original; factory reply is history-only (never both in active)
